description: This file contains unit tests for the DeviceModelCatalog component, verifying its symbol generation logic based on device attributes such as device family, model identifier, and friendly name.

classes.name: DeviceModelCatalogTests
classes.description: A suite of unit tests for the DeviceModelCatalog's symbol and presentation functions.

methods.name: symbol prefers model identifier prefixes
methods.description: Tests that the symbol method uses model identifier prefixes for device variants.

methods.name: symbol uses friendly name for mac variants
methods.description: Verifies that the symbol method uses friendly names for Mac devices.

methods.name: symbol falls back to device family
methods.description: Ensures that the symbol method defaults to device family when model identifier and friendly name are unavailable.

methods.name: presentation uses bundled model mappings
methods.description: Checks that the presentation method returns the correct model mapping title based on device info.
